campaign: Northern Front Range Air Quality Study, Denver
blocking_reasons: The historical CMB-side fM rule is absent: source classification, carbon weighting, denominator, endmembers, inclusion rules, and negative-contribution handling are not defined.
key_sources: DRI Volume B; DRI Chapter 7; NIST report; reviewed NFRAQS dossier

blocking_reasons: Public tables provide dated grouped outputs and radiocarbon but omit per-day receptor vectors/uncertainties, numerical profile vectors/uncertainties, and exact daily profile/species choices; CMB PM share and 14C carbon share also use different denominators.

The report publishes profile appendices and daily final contributions, but not receptor chemistry/uncertainty matrices or exact sample-level final profile/species selections. Multiple combinations were tried until an optimal fit, making a clean preregistered selector unrecoverable.
key_sources: Ward et al. 2013 Alaska DEC report; Busby et al. 2016 DOI 10.4209/aaqr.2015.04.0235

blocking_reasons: The papers expose the algorithm, sample-specific species lists, CMB outputs, and same-run tracer endpoints, but not the complete 101-species receptor/profile matrices with uncertainties. The contrast is species selection, not alternative source-profile choice.
key_sources: Liu et al. 2010 DOI 10.1016/j.atmosenv.2010.06.005; Larson et al. 2011 DOI 10.5094/APR.2011.019

blocking_reasons: The article reports agreement for aggregated/site-season results, but no public package with sample-level receptor vectors, profile vectors, uncertainties, exact selectors, and endpoint crosswalk was recovered.

The article and dissertation chapter document a 24-day campaign and period-level comparison, but a complete sample-level receptor/profile/uncertainty package and exact profile-choice experiment were not recovered.
Open CMB field evidence was found, but the study has no same-sample independent source-discriminating reference and therefore cannot answer the Cycle 01 external-validation question.
